findings.passage: I also support transparency in our election systems so voters can have confidence in the electoral process. This includes advocating for clear election procedures, public accountability, voter education, and open communication about voter identification requirements and other election laws so every eligible voter understands their rights and responsibilities before casting a ballot.
findings.note: Campaign home page, civic engagement section. She supports clear election procedures and voter education, including open communication about voter identification requirements. It does not say what the requirements should be. The page carries no date, so the year is the date it was read.

findings.passage: As your representative, I will encourage civic engagement by supporting voter registration efforts, expanding access to nonpartisan civic education, and helping residents better understand how to participate in local, state, and federal elections.
findings.note: Campaign home page, same section. She supports voter registration efforts and civic education. No mention of proof of identity or citizenship. The page carries no date.
